title: List Of Chinese Troops Controlled By General Chiang

page_data.en:
(C.I.D.) Office Notes

A/D.C.I.

Attached is an up-to-date list in tabular form
of Chinese troops controlled by General Chiang Kai-shek,
Marshal Feng Yu-hsiang, Marshal Yen Shih-san and General
Chang Hsueh-liang.

I respectfully beg to suggest that copies be
sent to the Authorities concerned.

E. Park
D. S. I.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C.I.D. RECORDS File No. C. D. 611 November. 9, 1929.）

（批：Mc）

（批：For O'Leau, British, American
Consuls & Mukden）

（批：See）

（批：Instructions carried out
on November 9.
MC
11/9/29）
